```{r}
#==============================================================================
# MODULE 10 — Spatial inferCNV analysis
#==============================================================================

# Purpose:
#   Prepare tumor-bearing Visium spatial transcriptomic samples for inferCNV,
#   define candidate tumor-associated observation spots and reference spots
#   using spatial Seurat clusters, extract raw Spatial counts, validate the
#   mouse gene-order reference, generate inferCNV annotation files, run
#   inferCNV independently for each tumor-bearing slide, save completed
#   inferCNV objects and supporting files, and preserve the prepared spatial
#   Seurat objects for downstream CNV scoring and malignant-region
#   classification.
#
# Input:
#   data/processed/spatial/
#     spatial_integrated_clustered_seurat.rds
#
# Reference:
#   reference/
#     mouse_GRCm38_genome_infercnv.txt
#
# Prepared object output:
#   data/processed/spatial/infercnv/
#     infercnv_prepared_spatial_objects.rds
#
# inferCNV outputs:
#   results/spatial/infercnv/
#     Niacin_Treatment/
#     Vehicle_1/
#     Vehicle_2/
#
# Diagnostic figures:
#   figures/spatial/infercnv/
#
# inferCNV parameters:
#   Assay:                  Spatial
#   Raw expression:         counts
#   Candidate tumor cluster: 7
#   Reference groups:       all remaining clusters
#   Cutoff:                 0.1
#   Denoise:                TRUE
#   HMM:                    TRUE
#   Cluster by groups:      TRUE
#   Threads:                4
#   Leiden resolution:      0.01
#
# Notes:
#   - inferCNV is run independently for each tumor-bearing spatial slide.
#   - Normal_Tissue is retained separately and is not run through inferCNV.
#   - Raw Spatial counts are used. SCT-normalized values are not used.
#   - inferCNV identifies expression patterns consistent with broad CNV
#     events; it does not constitute direct DNA-based evidence of malignancy.
#   - CNV burden scoring and malignant-spot classification are intentionally
#     performed in the following module rather than in this module.
#==============================================================================


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Load required packages
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(Seurat)
  library(SeuratObject)
  library(infercnv)
  library(Matrix)
  library(dplyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(patchwork)
  library(here)
})


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Reproducibility settings
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

set.seed(1234)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Define analysis parameters
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

spatial_assay <- "Spatial"

sample_column <- "sample"

cluster_column <- "spatial_cluster"

annotation_column <- "infercnv_input_group"

num_threads <- 4

infercnv_cutoff <- 0.1

run_hmm <- TRUE

leiden_resolution <- 0.01

excluded_chromosomes <- c(
  "chrX",
  "chrY",
  "chrM"
)

tumor_samples <- c(
  "Niacin_Treatment",
  "Vehicle_1",
  "Vehicle_2"
)

normal_sample <- "Normal_Tissue"


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Define candidate tumor-associated clusters
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# IMPORTANT:
#   Cluster 7 is retained from the current validated working inferCNV script.
#
#   Cluster numbering is workflow-dependent and should not be assumed to be
#   biologically equivalent across independently processed datasets.
#
#   Users adapting this protocol must define candidate tumor-associated
#   clusters using their own histology, spatial organization, marker genes,
#   and other biological evidence.

candidate_tumor_clusters <- list(
  Niacin_Treatment = c("7"),
  Vehicle_1 = c("7"),
  Vehicle_2 = c("7")
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Define repository paths
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

processed_directory <- here::here(
  "data",
  "processed",
  "spatial"
)

infercnv_object_directory <- here::here(
  "data",
  "processed",
  "spatial",
  "infercnv"
)

results_directory <- here::here(
  "results",
  "spatial",
  "infercnv"
)

figure_directory <- here::here(
  "figures",
  "spatial",
  "infercnv"
)

reference_directory <- here::here(
  "reference"
)

directories_to_create <- c(
  infercnv_object_directory,
  results_directory,
  figure_directory
)

for (directory in directories_to_create) {
  dir.create(
    directory,
    recursive = TRUE,
    showWarnings = FALSE
  )
}

input_file <- file.path(
  processed_directory,
  "spatial_integrated_clustered_seurat.rds"
)

gene_order_file <- file.path(
  reference_directory,
  "mouse_GRCm38_genome_infercnv.txt"
)

prepared_object_file <- file.path(
  infercnv_object_directory,
  "infercnv_prepared_spatial_objects.rds"
)

analysis_manifest_file <- file.path(
  results_directory,
  "spatial_infercnv_analysis_manifest.csv"
)

parameter_file <- file.path(
  results_directory,
  "spatial_infercnv_parameters.csv"
)


cat(
  "\n============================================================\n",
  "MODULE 10 — Spatial inferCNV analysis\n",
  "============================================================\n",
  "Repository root:       ", here::here(), "\n",
  "Input object:          ", input_file, "\n",
  "Gene-order reference:  ", gene_order_file, "\n",
  "Prepared objects:      ", infercnv_object_directory, "\n",
  "inferCNV results:      ", results_directory, "\n",
  "Diagnostic figures:   ", figure_directory, "\n",
  "============================================================\n\n",
  sep = ""
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Validate and load integrated spatial object
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

if (!file.exists(input_file)) {
  stop(
    "Integrated spatial Seurat object was not found:\n",
    input_file,
    "\n\nRun the spatial processing modules before Module 10."
  )
}

cat(
  "Loading integrated spatial Seurat object...\n"
)

spatial_object <- readRDS(
  input_file
)

if (!inherits(spatial_object, "Seurat")) {
  stop(
    "Loaded input file is not a valid Seurat object."
  )
}

available_assays <- names(
  spatial_object@assays
)

if (!spatial_assay %in% available_assays) {
  stop(
    "Required Spatial assay was not found.\n",
    "Available assays: ",
    paste(
      available_assays,
      collapse = ", "
    )
  )
}

required_metadata <- c(
  sample_column,
  cluster_column
)

missing_metadata <- setdiff(
  required_metadata,
  colnames(spatial_object@meta.data)
)

if (length(missing_metadata) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Required metadata column(s) missing:\n",
    paste(
      missing_metadata,
      collapse = ", "
    )
  )
}

Seurat::DefaultAssay(
  spatial_object
) <- spatial_assay

cat(
  "Spatial object loaded successfully:\n",
  "  Features: ", nrow(spatial_object), "\n",
  "  Spots:    ", ncol(spatial_object), "\n",
  "  Samples:  ",
  length(
    unique(
      spatial_object@meta.data[[sample_column]]
    )
  ),
  "\n",
  "  Clusters: ",
  length(
    unique(
      spatial_object@meta.data[[cluster_column]]
    )
  ),
  "\n",
  sep = ""
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Validate expected samples
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

expected_samples <- c(
  normal_sample,
  tumor_samples
)

observed_samples <- sort(
  unique(
    as.character(
      spatial_object@meta.data[[sample_column]]
    )
  )
)

missing_samples <- setdiff(
  expected_samples,
  observed_samples
)

if (length(missing_samples) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Expected spatial sample(s) missing:\n",
    paste(
      missing_samples,
      collapse = ", "
    )
  )
}

cat(
  "\nSpatial spots by sample:\n"
)

print(
  table(
    spatial_object@meta.data[[sample_column]]
  )
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 8. Validate raw Spatial counts
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "\n------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "Validating raw Spatial counts\n",
  "------------------------------------------------------------\n"
)

spatial_layers <- SeuratObject::Layers(
  spatial_object[[spatial_assay]]
)

cat(
  "Spatial assay layers:\n"
)

print(
  spatial_layers
)

if (sum(grepl("^counts", spatial_layers)) > 1) {
  cat(
    "\nMultiple Spatial count layers detected.\n",
    "Joining Spatial assay layers before inferCNV...\n",
    sep = ""
  )

  spatial_object <- SeuratObject::JoinLayers(
    spatial_object,
    assay = spatial_assay
  )
}

spatial_layers <- SeuratObject::Layers(
  spatial_object[[spatial_assay]]
)

if (!"counts" %in% spatial_layers) {
  stop(
    "A single raw 'counts' layer was not available after layer preparation."
  )
}

raw_count_check <- Seurat::GetAssayData(
  object = spatial_object,
  assay = spatial_assay,
  layer = "counts"
)

if (nrow(raw_count_check) == 0 || ncol(raw_count_check) == 0) {
  stop(
    "Raw Spatial count matrix is empty."
  )
}

cat(
  "Raw Spatial counts confirmed:\n",
  "  Genes: ", nrow(raw_count_check), "\n",
  "  Spots: ", ncol(raw_count_check), "\n",
  sep = ""
)

rm(
  raw_count_check
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 9. Validate inferCNV gene-order file
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "\n------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "Validating inferCNV gene-order reference\n",
  "------------------------------------------------------------\n"
)

if (!file.exists(gene_order_file)) {
  stop(
    "inferCNV gene-order file was not found:\n",
    gene_order_file
  )
}

gene_order_check <- utils::read.delim(
  gene_order_file,
  header = FALSE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

if (ncol(gene_order_check) < 4) {
  stop(
    "Gene-order file contains fewer than four columns."
  )
}

gene_order_check <- gene_order_check[, 1:4]

colnames(gene_order_check) <- c(
  "gene",
  "chromosome",
  "start",
  "end"
)

if (anyDuplicated(gene_order_check$gene) > 0) {
  warning(
    "Duplicated genes were detected in the inferCNV gene-order file."
  )
}

if (any(is.na(gene_order_check$start)) ||
    any(is.na(gene_order_check$end))) {
  stop(
    "Missing genomic coordinates were detected in the gene-order file."
  )
}

shared_gene_order_genes <- intersect(
  rownames(spatial_object),
  gene_order_check$gene
)

cat(
  "Gene-order reference:\n",
  "  Rows:             ", nrow(gene_order_check), "\n",
  "  Spatial genes:    ", nrow(spatial_object), "\n",
  "  Shared genes:     ", length(shared_gene_order_genes), "\n",
  "  Shared fraction:  ",
  round(
    100 *
      length(shared_gene_order_genes) /
      nrow(spatial_object),
    2
  ),
  "%\n",
  sep = ""
)

if (length(shared_gene_order_genes) == 0) {
  stop(
    "No shared genes were found between the spatial object and gene-order file."
  )
}


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 10. Save gene-order validation summary
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

gene_order_summary <- data.frame(
  spatial_genes = nrow(spatial_object),
  gene_order_genes = nrow(gene_order_check),
  shared_genes = length(shared_gene_order_genes),
  shared_percent = 100 *
    length(shared_gene_order_genes) /
    nrow(spatial_object)
)

gene_order_summary_file <- file.path(
  results_directory,
  "spatial_infercnv_gene_order_summary.csv"
)

utils::write.csv(
  gene_order_summary,
  gene_order_summary_file,
  row.names = FALSE
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 11. Split normal and tumor-bearing spatial samples
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "\n------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "Separating spatial samples\n",
  "------------------------------------------------------------\n"
)

sample_vector <- as.character(
  spatial_object@meta.data[[sample_column]]
)

normal_cells <- colnames(spatial_object)[
  sample_vector == normal_sample
]

normal_seurat <- subset(
  spatial_object,
  cells = normal_cells
)

sample_objects <- list()

for (sample_name in tumor_samples) {
  sample_cells <- colnames(spatial_object)[
    sample_vector == sample_name
  ]

  if (length(sample_cells) == 0) {
    stop(
      "No spatial spots were found for tumor sample: ",
      sample_name
    )
  }

  sample_objects[[sample_name]] <- subset(
    spatial_object,
    cells = sample_cells
  )
}

cat(
  "Normal tissue spots: ",
  ncol(normal_seurat),
  "\n",
  sep = ""
)

cat(
  "\nTumor-bearing spatial spot counts:\n"
)

print(
  vapply(
    sample_objects,
    ncol,
    numeric(1)
  )
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 12. Define sample-to-image mapping
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

image_sample_map <- data.frame(
  sample_name = c(
    "Niacin_Treatment",
    "Vehicle_1",
    "Vehicle_2"
  ),
  image_name = c(
    "Niacin2_B5",
    "Vehicle1_C5",
    "Vehicle2_D5"
  ),
  display_name = c(
    "Niacin B5",
    "Vehicle C5",
    "Vehicle D5"
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 13. Visualize spatial clusters before inferCNV grouping
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "\n------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "Visualizing spatial clusters before inferCNV grouping\n",
  "------------------------------------------------------------\n"
)

cluster_plot_files <- character(0)

for (i in seq_len(nrow(image_sample_map))) {
  sample_name <- image_sample_map$sample_name[i]

  image_name <- image_sample_map$image_name[i]

  display_name <- image_sample_map$display_name[i]

  sample_object <- sample_objects[[sample_name]]

  if (!image_name %in% Seurat::Images(sample_object)) {
    warning(
      "Image ",
      image_name,
      " was not found for ",
      sample_name
    )

    next
  }

  cluster_plot <- Seurat::SpatialDimPlot(
    sample_object,
    group.by = cluster_column,
    images = image_name,
    label = TRUE,
    label.size = 4,
    repel = TRUE,
    pt.size.factor = 1.6
  ) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title = paste0(
        display_name,
        " — spatial clusters"
      ),
      fill = "Cluster"
    ) +
    ggplot2::theme(
      plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(
        hjust = 0.5,
        face = "bold"
      )
    )

  cluster_plot_file <- file.path(
    figure_directory,
    paste0(
      sample_name,
      "_spatial_clusters_before_infercnv.png"
    )
  )

  ggplot2::ggsave(
    filename = cluster_plot_file,
    plot = cluster_plot,
    width = 8,
    height = 8,
    dpi = 600
  )

  cluster_plot_files <- c(
    cluster_plot_files,
    cluster_plot_file
  )
}


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 14. Validate candidate tumor-associated clusters
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "\n------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "Validating candidate tumor-associated clusters\n",
  "------------------------------------------------------------\n"
)

for (sample_name in names(sample_objects)) {
  observed_clusters <- unique(
    as.character(
      sample_objects[[sample_name]]@meta.data[[cluster_column]]
    )
  )

  requested_clusters <- as.character(
    candidate_tumor_clusters[[sample_name]]
  )

  missing_candidate_clusters <- setdiff(
    requested_clusters,
    observed_clusters
  )

  if (length(missing_candidate_clusters) > 0) {
    stop(
      "Candidate tumor cluster(s) not found for ",
      sample_name,
      ": ",
      paste(
        missing_candidate_clusters,
        collapse = ", "
      )
    )
  }

  cat(
    sample_name,
    " candidate tumor cluster(s): ",
    paste(
      requested_clusters,
      collapse = ", "
    ),
    "\n",
    sep = ""
  )
}


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 15. Define reference clusters
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

reference_clusters <- list()

for (sample_name in names(sample_objects)) {
  observed_clusters <- unique(
    as.character(
      sample_objects[[sample_name]]@meta.data[[cluster_column]]
    )
  )

  reference_clusters[[sample_name]] <- setdiff(
    observed_clusters,
    as.character(
      candidate_tumor_clusters[[sample_name]]
    )
  )

  if (length(reference_clusters[[sample_name]]) == 0) {
    stop(
      "No reference clusters remained for sample: ",
      sample_name
    )
  }
}


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 16. Define function to assign inferCNV input groups
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

make_infercnv_groups <- function(
    seurat_object,
    candidate_clusters,
    reference_clusters,
    cluster_column
) {
  clusters <- as.character(
    seurat_object@meta.data[[cluster_column]]
  )

  groups <- dplyr::case_when(
    clusters %in% as.character(candidate_clusters) ~ "observation",
    clusters %in% as.character(reference_clusters) ~ "reference",
    TRUE ~ "excluded"
  )

  names(groups) <- colnames(
    seurat_object
  )

  return(
    groups
  )
}


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 17. Assign inferCNV input groups
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "\n------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "Assigning inferCNV input groups\n",
  "------------------------------------------------------------\n"
)

for (sample_name in names(sample_objects)) {
  sample_objects[[sample_name]]$infercnv_input_group <-
    make_infercnv_groups(
      seurat_object = sample_objects[[sample_name]],
      candidate_clusters = candidate_tumor_clusters[[sample_name]],
      reference_clusters = reference_clusters[[sample_name]],
      cluster_column = cluster_column
    )
}

cat(
  "\ninferCNV input-group counts:\n"
)

for (sample_name in names(sample_objects)) {
  cat(
    "\n",
    sample_name,
    ":\n",
    sep = ""
  )

  print(
    table(
      sample_objects[[sample_name]]$infercnv_input_group
    )
  )
}


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 18. Create inferCNV input-group summary table
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

input_group_summary <- data.frame()

for (sample_name in names(sample_objects)) {
  current_counts <- as.data.frame(
    table(
      sample_objects[[sample_name]]$infercnv_input_group
    ),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  colnames(current_counts) <- c(
    "infercnv_group",
    "spots"
  )

  current_counts$sample <- sample_name

  input_group_summary <- rbind(
    input_group_summary,
    current_counts
  )
}

input_group_summary <- input_group_summary[, c(
  "sample",
  "infercnv_group",
  "spots"
)]

input_group_summary_file <- file.path(
  results_directory,
  "spatial_infercnv_input_group_summary.csv"
)

utils::write.csv(
  input_group_summary,
  input_group_summary_file,
  row.names = FALSE
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 19. Visualize inferCNV input groups spatially
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "\n------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "Visualizing inferCNV input groups\n",
  "------------------------------------------------------------\n"
)

input_group_plot_files <- character(0)

input_group_plot_list <- list()

for (i in seq_len(nrow(image_sample_map))) {
  sample_name <- image_sample_map$sample_name[i]

  image_name <- image_sample_map$image_name[i]

  display_name <- image_sample_map$display_name[i]

  sample_object <- sample_objects[[sample_name]]

  if (!image_name %in% Seurat::Images(sample_object)) {
    warning(
      "Image ",
      image_name,
      " was not found for ",
      sample_name
    )

    next
  }

  input_group_plot <- Seurat::SpatialDimPlot(
    object = sample_object,
    group.by = annotation_column,
    images = image_name,
    pt.size.factor = 1.6
  ) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title = paste0(
        display_name,
        " — inferCNV input groups"
      ),
      fill = "Input group"
    ) +
    ggplot2::theme(
      plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(
        hjust = 0.5,
        face = "bold"
      )
    )

  input_group_plot_file <- file.path(
    figure_directory,
    paste0(
      sample_name,
      "_infercnv_input_groups.png"
    )
  )

  ggplot2::ggsave(
    filename = input_group_plot_file,
    plot = input_group_plot,
    width = 8,
    height = 8,
    dpi = 600
  )

  input_group_plot_files <- c(
    input_group_plot_files,
    input_group_plot_file
  )

  input_group_plot_list[[sample_name]] <- input_group_plot
}


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 20. Save combined inferCNV input-group overview
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

combined_input_group_file <- NULL

if (length(input_group_plot_list) > 0) {
  combined_input_group_plot <- patchwork::wrap_plots(
    input_group_plot_list,
    ncol = 3
  )

  combined_input_group_file <- file.path(
    figure_directory,
    "spatial_infercnv_input_groups_all_slides.png"
  )

  ggplot2::ggsave(
    filename = combined_input_group_file,
    plot = combined_input_group_plot,
    width = 18,
    height = 6,
    dpi = 600
  )
}


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 21. Save inferCNV-prepared spatial objects
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "\n------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "Saving inferCNV-prepared spatial objects\n",
  "------------------------------------------------------------\n"
)

prepared_spatial_objects <- list(
  Normal_Tissue = normal_seurat,
  Tumor_Samples = sample_objects
)

saveRDS(
  object = prepared_spatial_objects,
  file = prepared_object_file,
  compress = TRUE
)

if (!file.exists(prepared_object_file)) {
  stop(
    "inferCNV-prepared spatial objects were not saved successfully."
  )
}

cat(
  "Prepared spatial objects saved successfully:\n",
  prepared_object_file,
  "\n",
  sep = ""
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 22. Save inferCNV analysis parameters
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

candidate_cluster_string <- paste(
  unique(
    unlist(
      candidate_tumor_clusters
    )
  ),
  collapse = ","
)

infercnv_parameters <- data.frame(
  parameter = c(
    "spatial_assay",
    "sample_column",
    "cluster_column",
    "annotation_column",
    "candidate_tumor_cluster",
    "reference_definition",
    "cutoff",
    "HMM",
    "denoise",
    "cluster_by_groups",
    "num_threads",
    "leiden_resolution",
    "excluded_chromosomes"
  ),
  value = c(
    spatial_assay,
    sample_column,
    cluster_column,
    annotation_column,
    candidate_cluster_string,
    "All clusters except candidate tumor cluster",
    infercnv_cutoff,
    run_hmm,
    TRUE,
    TRUE,
    num_threads,
    leiden_resolution,
    paste(
      excluded_chromosomes,
      collapse = ","
    )
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

utils::write.csv(
  infercnv_parameters,
  parameter_file,
  row.names = FALSE
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 23. Define inferCNV analysis function
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

run_spatial_infercnv <- function(
    seurat_object,
    sample_name,
    gene_order_file,
    results_directory,
    spatial_assay,
    annotation_column,
    cutoff,
    num_threads,
    run_hmm,
    leiden_resolution,
    excluded_chromosomes
) {
  cat(
    "\n============================================================\n",
    "Running inferCNV — ",
    sample_name,
    "\n",
    "============================================================\n",
    sep = ""
  )

  if (!annotation_column %in% colnames(seurat_object@meta.data)) {
    stop(
      "inferCNV annotation column was not found for ",
      sample_name,
      ": ",
      annotation_column
    )
  }

  assay_layers <- SeuratObject::Layers(
    seurat_object[[spatial_assay]]
  )

  if (sum(grepl("^counts", assay_layers)) > 1) {
    seurat_object <- SeuratObject::JoinLayers(
      seurat_object,
      assay = spatial_assay
    )
  }

  if (!"counts" %in% SeuratObject::Layers(
    seurat_object[[spatial_assay]]
  )) {
    stop(
      "Raw counts layer was not available for ",
      sample_name
    )
  }

  raw_counts <- Seurat::GetAssayData(
    object = seurat_object,
    assay = spatial_assay,
    layer = "counts"
  )

  raw_counts <- methods::as(
    raw_counts,
    "dgCMatrix"
  )

  metadata <- seurat_object@meta.data[
    colnames(raw_counts),
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  annotation <- data.frame(
    infercnv_group = as.character(
      metadata[[annotation_column]]
    ),
    row.names = rownames(metadata),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  keep_spots <- rownames(annotation)[
    annotation$infercnv_group %in%
      c(
        "reference",
        "observation"
      )
  ]

  raw_counts <- raw_counts[
    ,
    keep_spots,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  annotation <- annotation[
    keep_spots,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  if (!identical(
    colnames(raw_counts),
    rownames(annotation)
  )) {
    stop(
      "Count matrix and inferCNV annotations are not aligned for ",
      sample_name
    )
  }

  group_counts <- table(
    annotation$infercnv_group
  )

  cat(
    "\nInput groups:\n"
  )

  print(
    group_counts
  )

  if (!"reference" %in% names(group_counts)) {
    stop(
      "No reference spots were selected for ",
      sample_name
    )
  }

  if (!"observation" %in% names(group_counts)) {
    stop(
      "No observation spots were selected for ",
      sample_name
    )
  }

  sample_output_directory <- file.path(
    results_directory,
    sample_name
  )

  dir.create(
    sample_output_directory,
    recursive = TRUE,
    showWarnings = FALSE
  )

  annotation_file <- file.path(
    sample_output_directory,
    paste0(
      sample_name,
      "_infercnv_annotations.tsv"
    )
  )

  annotation_export <- data.frame(
    spot = rownames(annotation),
    group = annotation$infercnv_group,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  utils::write.table(
    annotation_export,
    file = annotation_file,
    sep = "\t",
    quote = FALSE,
    row.names = FALSE,
    col.names = FALSE
  )

  if (!file.exists(annotation_file)) {
    stop(
      "inferCNV annotation file was not written for ",
      sample_name
    )
  }

  cat(
    "Creating inferCNV object...\n"
  )

  infercnv_object <- infercnv::CreateInfercnvObject(
    raw_counts_matrix = raw_counts,
    annotations_file = annotation_file,
    delim = "\t",
    gene_order_file = gene_order_file,
    ref_group_names = "reference",
    chr_exclude = excluded_chromosomes
  )

  cat(
    "Running inferCNV...\n",
    "Output directory: ",
    sample_output_directory,
    "\n",
    sep = ""
  )

  infercnv_result <- infercnv::run(
    infercnv_object,
    cutoff = cutoff,
    out_dir = sample_output_directory,
    cluster_by_groups = TRUE,
    denoise = TRUE,
    HMM = run_hmm,
    num_threads = num_threads,
    leiden_resolution = leiden_resolution,
    plot_steps = FALSE
  )

  result_rds_file <- file.path(
    sample_output_directory,
    paste0(
      sample_name,
      "_infercnv_result.rds"
    )
  )

  saveRDS(
    object = infercnv_result,
    file = result_rds_file,
    compress = TRUE
  )

  if (!file.exists(result_rds_file)) {
    stop(
      "Final inferCNV RDS object was not saved for ",
      sample_name
    )
  }

  cat(
    "inferCNV completed successfully for ",
    sample_name,
    ".\n",
    sep = ""
  )

  return(
    list(
      infercnv_result = infercnv_result,
      output_directory = sample_output_directory,
      annotation_file = annotation_file,
      result_file = result_rds_file,
      annotation = annotation,
      input_spots = ncol(raw_counts),
      reference_spots = unname(group_counts["reference"]),
      observation_spots = unname(group_counts["observation"])
    )
  )
}


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 24. Run inferCNV across tumor-bearing samples
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "\n============================================================\n",
  "Starting sample-level inferCNV analyses\n",
  "============================================================\n"
)

infercnv_results <- list()

for (sample_name in names(sample_objects)) {
  infercnv_results[[sample_name]] <- run_spatial_infercnv(
    seurat_object = sample_objects[[sample_name]],
    sample_name = sample_name,
    gene_order_file = gene_order_file,
    results_directory = results_directory,
    spatial_assay = spatial_assay,
    annotation_column = annotation_column,
    cutoff = infercnv_cutoff,
    num_threads = num_threads,
    run_hmm = run_hmm,
    leiden_resolution = leiden_resolution,
    excluded_chromosomes = excluded_chromosomes
  )
}

cat(
  "\nAll tumor-bearing spatial inferCNV analyses completed.\n"
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 25. Create inferCNV analysis manifest
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

analysis_manifest <- data.frame(
  sample = names(infercnv_results),
  input_spots = vapply(
    infercnv_results,
    function(x) x$input_spots,
    numeric(1)
  ),
  reference_spots = vapply(
    infercnv_results,
    function(x) x$reference_spots,
    numeric(1)
  ),
  observation_spots = vapply(
    infercnv_results,
    function(x) x$observation_spots,
    numeric(1)
  ),
  output_directory = vapply(
    infercnv_results,
    function(x) x$output_directory,
    character(1)
  ),
  annotation_file = vapply(
    infercnv_results,
    function(x) x$annotation_file,
    character(1)
  ),
  result_file = vapply(
    infercnv_results,
    function(x) x$result_file,
    character(1)
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

utils::write.csv(
  analysis_manifest,
  analysis_manifest_file,
  row.names = FALSE
)

cat(
  "\n------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "inferCNV analysis manifest\n",
  "------------------------------------------------------------\n"
)

print(
  analysis_manifest
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 26. Save lightweight inferCNV result index
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

infercnv_result_index <- lapply(
  infercnv_results,
  function(x) {
    list(
      output_directory = x$output_directory,
      annotation_file = x$annotation_file,
      result_file = x$result_file,
      input_spots = x$input_spots,
      reference_spots = x$reference_spots,
      observation_spots = x$observation_spots
    )
  }
)

infercnv_result_index_file <- file.path(
  infercnv_object_directory,
  "spatial_infercnv_result_index.rds"
)

saveRDS(
  object = infercnv_result_index,
  file = infercnv_result_index_file,
  compress = TRUE
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 27. Save session information
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

session_info_file <- file.path(
  results_directory,
  "spatial_infercnv_sessionInfo.txt"
)

writeLines(
  capture.output(
    sessionInfo()
  ),
  con = session_info_file
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 28. Validate expected Module 10 outputs
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

expected_object_files <- c(
  prepared_object_file,
  infercnv_result_index_file
)

expected_result_files <- c(
  gene_order_summary_file,
  input_group_summary_file,
  parameter_file,
  analysis_manifest_file,
  session_info_file
)

expected_infercnv_result_files <- vapply(
  infercnv_results,
  function(x) x$result_file,
  character(1)
)

expected_annotation_files <- vapply(
  infercnv_results,
  function(x) x$annotation_file,
  character(1)
)

expected_figure_files <- c(
  cluster_plot_files,
  input_group_plot_files
)

if (!is.null(combined_input_group_file)) {
  expected_figure_files <- c(
    expected_figure_files,
    combined_input_group_file
  )
}

missing_object_files <- expected_object_files[
  !file.exists(expected_object_files)
]

missing_result_files <- expected_result_files[
  !file.exists(expected_result_files)
]

missing_infercnv_files <- expected_infercnv_result_files[
  !file.exists(expected_infercnv_result_files)
]

missing_annotation_files <- expected_annotation_files[
  !file.exists(expected_annotation_files)
]

missing_figure_files <- expected_figure_files[

]

if (length(missing_object_files) > 0) {
  stop(

if (length(missing_result_files) > 0) {

}

if (length(missing_infercnv_files) > 0) {

if (length(missing_figure_files) > 0) {
```
